name: create_video_translation
description: Translates a video into one or more target languages with voice cloning and lip-sync. Returns one video_translation_id per language. Use mode: 'speed' (default) for fast turnaround or 'precision' for higher lip-sync quality.

video.description: Source video — provide as {type: 'url', url: '...'} or {type: 'asset_id', asset_id: '...'}
video.title: Video

outputLanguages.description: Target language names (e.g. 'Chinese (Cantonese, Traditional)', 'Spanish (Spain)', 'English'). Use GET /v3/video-translations/languages for valid values. Use one for single translation, multiple for batch.
outputLanguages.title: Outputlanguages

audio.description: Custom audio for dubbing — provide as {type: 'url', url: '...'} or {type: 'asset_id', asset_id: '...'}
audio.title: Audio

translateAudioOnly.description: Only translate audio, keep original video
translateAudioOnly.title: Translateaudioonly

mode.description: Translation quality mode: 'speed' (faster) or 'precision' (higher quality, uses avatar inference)
mode.title: Mode

keepTheSameFormat.description: Preserve the source video's encoding specs (resolution, bitrate).
keepTheSameFormat.title: Keepthesameformat

startTime.description: Start time in seconds for partial translation
startTime.title: Starttime

endTime.description: End time in seconds for partial translation
endTime.title: Endtime

brandVoiceId.description: Brand glossary ID for custom term translations. Legacy field name for `brand_glossary_id` — both are accepted and resolve to the same workspace record. Discover IDs via GET /v3/brand-glossaries.
brandVoiceId.title: Brandvoiceid

brandGlossaryId.description: Brand glossary ID for custom term translations (e.g. translate 'Reformer' as the Pilates equipment, not 'political activist'). Alias for the legacy `brand_voice_id` field. Discover IDs via GET /v3/brand-glossaries.
brandGlossaryId.title: Brandglossaryid

stockVoiceConfig.description: Use a preset stock voice for the translation instead of recreating the original speaker's voice. By default, Video Translation clones the original speaker so the result sounds like them; with this enabled, the translation is spoken by a natural preset voice optimized for clear pronunciation and accent in the target language (the result will not sound like the original speaker). Enterprise feature, available for selected accounts and languages by request — contact your HeyGen account team.

srt.description: Custom subtitle file — provide as {type: 'url', url: '...'} or {type: 'asset_id', asset_id: '...'}. Enterprise plan only.
srt.title: Srt

srtRole.description: Which video the subtitle applies to: 'input' (source) or 'output' (translated). Enterprise plan only.
srtRole.title: Srtrole

fpsMode.description: Frame rate mode for the output video. 'vfr' = variable frame rate, 'cfr' = constant frame rate, 'passthrough' = match the source. Only takes effect when a custom 'audio' track is provided.
fpsMode.title: Fpsmode

folderId.description: Project/folder ID to organize translation into
folderId.title: Folderid

AssetId.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint
asset_id.title: Asset Id

AssetId.title: AssetId

AssetUrl.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset
url.title: Url

AssetUrl.title: AssetUrl

StockVoiceConfig.description:
Stock-voice options for a video translation request.

Use a preset HeyGen voice for the translation instead of recreating the original
speaker's voice. Enterprise feature, available for selected accounts and languages
by request. See the ``stock_voice_config`` request field for usage.

use_stock_voice.description: Set to true to use a preset stock voice instead of cloning the original speaker.
use_stock_voice.title: Use Stock Voice

preferred_stock_voice_ids.description: Optional. Pin specific stock voice IDs to draw from. If omitted, the target language's default stock-voice pool is used.
preferred_stock_voice_ids.title: Preferred Stock Voice Ids

StockVoiceConfig.title: StockVoiceConfig
